label: Agostino Vespucci
summary: Florentine chancery official whose marginal note of October 1503 names a head of Lisa del Giocondo by Leonardo.

claims.statement: In a copy of Cicero, Epistulae ad familiares (Bologna, 1477), now in Heidelberg University Library, Vespucci wrote beside a passage on Apelles: 'Apelles pictor. Ita Leonardus Vincius facit in omnibus suis picturis, ut enim caput Lise del Giocondo et Anne matris virginis', with mention of the hall of the great council and the date '1503 octobris'. Noticed by librarian Armin Schlechter in 2005; announced 2008. Shelfmark reported as D 7620 qt. INC.
